latest_release.name: v0.1.27
latest_release.body:
Delete Local SEO businesses and change their area, Lighthouse results over MCP, and more complete site audits.

## What's new

- Delete a tracked business or change its area in Local SEO
- Read Lighthouse results with the new `get_audit_lighthouse` MCP tool
- Audits that stop at their page limit now say so
- `finalUrls` option on `get_serp_results` for page URLs instead of Google redirect links
  - Takes a few minutes instead of seconds

## Fixed

- Site audits that hit their page limit no longer use it up on tag pages and skip pages in your sitemap.
- Site audits no longer report a site's bot-check page as the real page.
- Keyword Research shows the keyword you searched in the overview card.
- `get_local_rank_grid` no longer counts a similarly named business as yours when you give its cid.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.26...v0.1.27

detail.readme: # OpenSEO > Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs OpenSEO is an SEO tool for _the people_. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control. > All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent. Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs. ## Hosted Version Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month. [openseo.so](https://openseo.so) ### EveryApp Host OpenSEO and other open source apps on our platform EveryApp. [Self-host on EveryApp and give it a star →](https://github.com/every-app/every-app) ## Why use OpenSEO? - Best in class MCP and AI Skills. - Modern, simple UI. - Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite. - No subscriptions. - Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use. - Fork and vibe code your own custom tool. ## Main SEO Workflows - Keyword research - Rank tracking - Competitor Insights - Backlinks - Site Audits - AI Visibility ## OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP. - [Set up ChatGPT web or desktop](https://openseo.so/docs/chatgpt) (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans) - [Set up Codex](https://openseo.so/docs/codex-plugin) - [Set up OpenSEO MCP](https://openseo.so/docs/mcp) - [Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://openseo.so/docs/skills/setup) ## Self-Hosting OpenSEO supports two self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts. - **Docker** - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md). - Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; [move to the new setup](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#move-from-the-old-docker-image) when you are ready, data included. - **Cloudflare** - No server to run: one deploy command puts OpenSEO on your own Cloudflare account (works on the free plan). See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls: - **Cloudflare Access** in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). - **No sign-in on Docker**, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See [Without sign-in](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#without-sign-in-advanced). Either way, you need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data. See [`docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md`](./docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md). ## Costs OpenSEO needs a [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/?aff=255379) API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting. See [openseo.so/pricing](https://openseo.so/pricing) When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO. ## Local Development See [`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Contributing Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute. Read more here: [`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) We have this skill: `/simple-issue-description` which helps. ```sh npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description ``` ## Community Join Discord to chat: [Discord](https://discord.gg/c9uGs3cFXr) Follow along for updates: - Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu - Sign up for the mailing list on our website: [openseo.so](https://openseo.so)
